summary: Test specification and test code for PD-08 (Definition snapshot) created. All 7 test cases from acceptance criteria covered. zig build exits 0; zig build test-integration compiles cleanly (runtime failures due to missing BPM_TEST_DB_URL are expected). Pre-existing compile error in pd03_version_test.zig (USER_TASK → HUMAN_TASK) fixed as a blocker.

test_cases.title: Create snapshot — happy path returns Snapshot with matching fields
Snapshot is independent of subsequent definition update
getByInstanceId with no snapshot returns DefinitionNotFound
Snapshot round-trip preserves node types, edge conditions, and is_default
Two instances from same definition have independent snapshots

issues.description: Pre-existing compile error in tests/integration/pd03_version_test.zig: .USER_TASK does not exist in NodeType enum. Fixed to .HUMAN_TASK with required role attribute per Unblock-Everything directive.

build_verification.zig_build_test_integration: COMPILES — runtime failures expected without BPM_TEST_DB_URL
